answer: Bonded collateral escrows make each identity costly, but do not alone prevent splitting. If evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, pairwise correlation drives penalties proportional to k²; upon detection, controlling the swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation of seized stake. Raven, pulse, and mirror checks supply independent correlation signals, so duplicating keys cannot dilute accountability: one proven scheme can consume the attackers’ pooled bond.
